result:
`bun run typecheck` and `bun test` (5 pass, 0 fail) both pass, and `bunx guren check` reports 0 failures.

**Summary:** `DashboardController.index` (`app/Http/Controllers/DashboardController.ts`) now additionally passes `postCount` — `Post.where({ authorId: currentUser.id }).count()` — and `recentPosts` — the same author-scoped query ordered `createdAt desc, id desc` (the id tiebreaker matters because `createdAt` is a stored ISO string), limited to 5 and mapped to `{ id, title }` — to the Inertia page; a signed-out request (which the auth middleware already prevents) falls back to `0`/`[]`. The page component `resources/js/pages/dashboard/Index.tsx` declares those two props and renders a new panel below the "Signed in as" card with a `You have N post(s)` line and a "Recent posts" list of `Link`s to `/posts/<id>`, falling back to a "You haven't written any posts yet." message plus a link to `/posts/create` when the list is empty. I re-ran `bunx guren codegen` so `PagePropsMap` picks up the new props, and added `tests/DashboardController.test.ts` covering the guest redirect, the empty state, and the count/ordering/author-scoping (7 own posts plus one by another user → count 7, five newest own titles newest-first).
